title: ObjectAgentManifest
description: YAML front matter for a kind:"object" agent shipped as agents/objects/<name>/SYSTEM.md. The markdown body below the closing --- is the system prompt. Graph agents use graph.schema.json instead (single graph.json per directory). The runtime loader filters to known keys and does not validate against this schema; it exists for authoring, CI, and editor tooling.

name.description: Object agent name. Graph 'agent' nodes reference this string in agent_registry.

description.description: What this object agent does. Not exposed on the parent task tool (object agents are internal).

kind.description: Must be 'object' for agents under agents/objects/.

model.description: Optional model override, e.g. 'azure_ai:tools-default'. Defaults to the parent agent's model.

tools.description: Tool names resolved against the parent's tool registry (e.g. git_command, gh_command, current_time).

skills.description: Skill source paths wired into SkillsMiddleware (e.g. /skills/<name>/).

mounts.description: Explicit virtual filesystem paths available to the agent. Paths must be beneath an existing Progenitor route.

permissions.description: Extra filesystem permissions layered on top of default skill-isolation rules.

interrupt_on.description: Tool names requiring human approval before executing (HumanInTheLoopMiddleware).
